findings.claim: Near-contact teacher v3 slowdown is not a post-latch force regulator.
findings.basis: slow_zone requiresGRASP, unlatched_before and notbilateral; bilateral means both readings above configured detection threshold.

findings.claim: Teacher first bilateral contact freezes the command; preserve_first_contact_command retains it after persistence and subsequent holding.
findings.basis: The one-time weight/stiffness candidate does not become a continuous normal-force target. Later default opening is latch_opening. Relative-pose/contact-loss stop logic is distinct.

findings.claim: Generic helper recomputes a candidate but ignores it while already frozen and bilateral. No friction load margin or force error feedback is applied in that branch.
findings.basis: Oncefrozen, decision=hold_contact_target and applied=frozen; only firstbilateral setsmin(previous,candidate). Threshold .03N is detection, not load adequacy.

findings.claim: Loss recovery cannot close past the logical request. Withlogical=previous=frozen, it cannot close at all.
findings.basis: This is a lower-bound restriction on total opening, independent of how much the weight candidate would suggest closing.

findings.claim: Direct teacher dispatch supplies its already-frozen opening as the generic logical request, rather than an independent deeper closure goal.
findings.basis: teacher.act returns explicitopening; env.step calls task conversion; without raw_model_action.gripper_opening_m, logical falls back to that opening. Teacher metadata also bypasses inherited policy re-latch branch.

engineering_formula_only.limitation: Engineering assumption from code. It does not calibrate true contact normals, effective friction, pressure centres or drive stiffness; no actual run force signal was read by this source-only review.

finite_conclusion: c793 guarantees no unintended reopening and bounded contact-loss closure toward a logical goal, but does not actively restore a friction-support margin while contact remains binary-positive. A frozen teacher goal can also block additional generic recovery closure. This is a demonstrated control limitation, not by itself a complete causal proof ofteacher_slow_close_01physicalfailure.
not_claimed: No claim that source-only inspection proves actual force insufficiency, drop onset or exact material slip in the closed run.
No tuning, gain/force/friction increase, threshold relaxation, new policy oracle or hidden teacher takeover is implemented.
No reinterpretation of historical success/failure labels.
